l-e-m1-b04-03.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta na enough na-abịa tupu okwu ọ na-akọwa mgbe niile bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, wee chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-m1-b04-03.material: Nkwupụta: A na-etinye enough tupu okwu a na-eji ya mgbe niile. Chọta okwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-m1-b04-03.s.s1.r.b: enough dị tupu time. Ọ bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m1-b04-03.s.s1.r.c: enough dị tupu chairs. Ọ bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m1-b04-03.s.s1.r.d: enough dị tupu water. Ọ bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m1-b04-03.s.s1.explain: Mgbe ọ na-akọwa nkọwa, enough na-abịa mgbe nkọwa, dị ka n'tall enough. Nke a dị iche na tupu aha.
l-e-m1-b04-03.s.s2.model.0: N'tall enough, enough dị mgbe tall, ya mere nkwupụta na ọ na-abịa nke mbụ mgbe niile adịghị mma.
l-e-m1-b04-03.s.s2.model.1: Ebe enough nwere ike ịbịa mgbe nkọwa, tall enough bụ ihe atụ megidere nkwupụta ahụ.

l-e-m1-b04-04.title: Must na have to bụ otu mgbe niile?
l-e-m1-b04-04.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta na must na have to pụrụ ịgbanwe mgbe niile bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, wee chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-m1-b04-04.material: Nkwupụta: Ahịrị okwu nwere must na-edebe otu ihe ọ pụtara mgbe a deghachiri ya site na have to mgbe niile. Chọta ụzọ na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-m1-b04-04.s.s1.r.a: Ha abụọ pụtara na ị ga-aga. Ọ bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m1-b04-04.s.s1.r.c: Ha abụọ pụtara na ị ga-eche. Ọ bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m1-b04-04.s.s1.r.d: Ha abụọ pụtara na ị ga-akwụsị. Ọ bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m1-b04-04.s.s1.explain: mustn't pụtara na ị ga-eme ya (mmachi), ma don't have to pụtara na ị chọghị ime ya. N'ahịrị okwu mmegide ihe ha pụtara dị iche.
l-e-m1-b04-04.s.s2.model.0: mustn't bụ mmachi ma don't have to pụtara na ọ dịghị mkpa ime ya, ya mere ihe ha pụtara dị iche ma nkwupụta ahụ adịghị mma.
l-e-m1-b04-04.s.s2.model.1: N'ahịrị okwu mmegide must na have to na-ewere ihe ọ pụtara dị iche, ya mere enweghị ike ịgbanwe ha mgbe niile.

l-e-m1-b04-05.title: Oge ugbu a na-aga n'ihu na-ekwu naanị banyere ugbu a?
l-e-m1-b04-05.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta na oge ugbu a na-aga n'ihu na-ekwu naanị banyere ihe na-eme ugbu a bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, wee chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-m1-b04-05.material: Nkwupụta: ngwaa be + verb-ing (oge ugbu a na-aga n'ihu) bụ naanị maka ihe na-eme ugbu a mgbe ị na-ekwu okwu. Chọta ahịrị okwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-m1-b04-05.s.s1.explain: A na-ekwukwa atụmatụ maka ọdịnihu dị nso n'oge ugbu a na-aga n'ihu. next Sunday abụghị ugbu a.

l-e-m1-b05-01.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta na ea nwere otu ụda mgbe niile ziri ezi mgbe niile, ma chọta ma kọwaa ikpe na-adabaghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-m1-b05-01.material: Nkwupụta: ea in a word always sounds like /ee/, as the ea in eat does. Chọta okwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-m1-b05-01.s.s1.r.b: ea bụ ụda /ee/. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m1-b05-01.s.s1.r.c: ea bụ ụda /ee/. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.

l-e-m1-b05-01.s.s1.explain: Ea dị n'bread na-ada /eh/. Ọbụlagodi otu ea nwere ụda dị iche dabere n'okwu ahụ.

l-e-m1-b05-02.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta na okwu nwere ọkpụkpụ yiri ibe ha nwere ihe ọ pụtara yiri ibe ha ziri ezi mgbe niile, ma chọta ma kọwaa ikpe na-adabaghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-m1-b05-02.material: Nkwupụta: Two words with similar spellings have similar meanings. Chọta ụzọ okwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-m1-b05-02.s.s1.r.a: Ọkpụkpụ dị iche ma ihe ọ pụtara bụ otu. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m1-b05-02.s.s1.r.b: Ọkpụkpụ dị iche ma ihe ọ pụtara bụ otu. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m1-b05-02.s.s1.r.d: Ọkpụkpụ dị iche ma ihe ọ pụtara bụ otu. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m1-b05-02.s.s1.explain: quite (n'ezie) na quiet (adịghị mkpọtụ) nwere ọkpụkpụ yiri ibe ha, ma ihe ha pụtara dị iche kpam kpam.
l-e-m1-b05-02.s.s2.model.0: quite pụtara n'ezie ma quiet pụtara adịghị mkpọtụ, ya mere ọbụlagodi na ọkpụkpụ yiri, ihe ha pụtara dị iche, nke na-eme nkwupụta ahụ ezighi ezi.
l-e-m1-b05-02.s.s2.model.1: Ọbụlagodi na ọkpụkpụ fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ otu, quite na quiet nwere ihe ha pụtara dị iche kpam kpam, ya mere ha bụ ihe atụ megidere.

l-e-m1-b05-03.title: Anyị na-agbakwunye -s mgbe ọnụọgụ mgbe niile?
l-e-m1-b05-03.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta na a na-agbakwunye -s n'okwu mgbe ọnụọgụ ziri ezi mgbe niile, ma chọta ma kọwaa ikpe na-adabaghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-m1-b05-03.material: Nkwupụta: A word after a number is always written with the plural -s. Chọta okwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-m1-b05-03.s.s1.r.a: E nwere -s mgbe ọnụọgụ. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m1-b05-03.s.s1.r.b: E nwere -s mgbe ọnụọgụ. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.

l-e-m1-b05-03.s.s1.explain: hundred anaghị ewere -s mgbe a na-eji ya na ọnụọgụ. five hundred ziri ezi.
l-e-m1-b05-03.s.s2.model.0: N'five hundred, hundred enweghị -s, ya mere nkwupụta na a na-agbakwunye -s mgbe ọnụọgụ mgbe niile ezighi ezi.
l-e-m1-b05-03.s.s2.model.1: A na-eji hundred na-enweghị -s ọbụlagodi mgbe ọnụọgụ, ya mere five hundred bụ ihe atụ megidere.

l-e-m1-b05-04.title: But ọ̀ nwere not mgbe ya mgbe niile?
l-e-m1-b05-04.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta na a na-agụnye okwu njụ mgbe but mgbe niile ziri ezi mgbe niile, ma chọta ma kọwaa ikpe na-adabaghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-m1-b05-04.material: Nkwupụta: The second sentence joined by but always has a negative word such as not or n't. Chọta ahịrịokwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-m1-b05-04.s.s1.r.b: E nwere couldn't. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m1-b05-04.s.s1.r.c: E nwere don't. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m1-b05-04.s.s1.r.d: E nwere isn't. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m1-b05-04.s.s1.explain: but na-ejikọta echiche na-emegide ibe ha. Ọbụlagodi na-enweghị not, enwere ike iji ya ma ọ bụrụ na echiche ndị ahụ na-emegide, dị ka ịdị oyi na inwe ọṅụ.

l-e-m1-b05-04.s.s2.model.1: Ịdị oyi na inwe ọṅụ na-emegide ibe ha, ya mere a na-eji but na-enweghị not. Ya mere ọ bụ ihe atụ megidere.

l-e-m1-b05-05.title: Ihe okwu agbakwunyere pụtara ọ̀ bụ nchikota nke ihe okwu ndị ahụ pụtara?
l-e-m1-b05-05.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta na ihe okwu agbakwunyere pụtara bụ nchikota nke ihe okwu abụọ pụtara ziri ezi mgbe niile, ma chọta ma kọwaa ikpe na-adabaghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-m1-b05-05.material: Nkwupụta: The meaning of a compound word made by joining two words is always the meanings of the two words added together. Chọta okwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-m1-b05-05.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụ ụlọ maka klaasị, ya mere o nwere ihe abụọ ahụ pụtara agbakwunyere.
l-e-m1-b05-05.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụ ụlọ nwere àkwà, ya mere o nwere ihe abụọ ahụ pụtara agbakwunyere.
l-e-m1-b05-05.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ brọsh maka ịsa ezé, ya mere o nwere ihe abụọ ahụ pụtara agbakwunyere.
l-e-m1-b05-05.s.s1.explain: butterfly abụghị butter na-efe efe. Ọ bụ ụmụ ahụhụ, butterfly. Ị nweghị ike ịmata ihe ọ pụtara site n'ịgbakwunye ihe okwu abụọ pụtara.
l-e-m1-b05-05.s.s2.model.0: butterfly pụtara ụmụ ahụhụ, ọ bụghị butter na-efe efe, ya mere nkwupụta ahụ ezighi ezi.
l-e-m1-b05-05.s.s2.model.1: Ịgbakwunye ihe okwu abụọ ahụ pụtara anaghị enye 'butterfly', ya mere butterfly bụ ihe atụ megidere ebe ihe okwu agbakwunyere pụtara dị iche na nchikota nke akụkụ ya.

l-e-m1-b06-01.title: -ing ọ̀ bụ omume na-eme ugbu a mgbe niile?
l-e-m1-b06-01.goal: Kpebie ma nkwupụta "Okwu na-agwụ na -ing na-akọwa omume na-eme ugbu a mgbe niile" bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, chọta ikpe ebe ọ bụghị (ihe atụ megidere), ma kọwaa ya.
l-e-m1-b06-01.material: Nkwupụta: Okwu ọ bụla na-agwụ na -ing na-akọwa omume na-eme ugbu a n'ezie. Chọta ahịrịokwu nke na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-m1-b06-01.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụ omume na-eme ugbu a. Ọ dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m1-b06-01.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụ omume ife efe na-eme ugbu a. Ọ dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m1-b06-01.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụ omume ịgụ na-eme ugbu a. Ọ dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m1-b06-01.s.s1.explain: N'"Swimming is fun.", Swimming abụghị omume na-eme ugbu a. Ọ na-akpọ aha omume iwu mmiri n'onwe ya.
l-e-m1-b06-01.s.s2.model.0: Swimming abụghị omume na-eme ugbu a. Ọ na-akpọ aha omume iwu mmiri, ya mere nkwupụta ahụ ezighị ezi.
l-e-m1-b06-01.s.s2.model.1: N'ahịrịokwu a, a na-eji okwu -ing dị ka subject ma ọ naghị akọwa omume na-eme ugbu a, ya mere ọ bụ ihe atụ megidere.

l-e-m1-b06-02.title: Ajụjụ Yes/No ọ̀ na-enweta naanị Yes ma ọ bụ No dị ka azịza?
l-e-m1-b06-02.goal: Kpebie ma nkwupụta "A pụrụ iji Yes ma ọ bụ No naanị zaa ajụjụ Yes/No" bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, chọta ikpe ebe ọ bụghị (ihe atụ megidere), ma kọwaa ya.
l-e-m1-b06-02.material: Nkwupụta: A pụrụ iji Yes ma ọ bụ No naanị zaa ajụjụ a na-aza site na Yes ma ọ bụ No, dị ka "Do you ...?" Chọta pair nke na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-m1-b06-02.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ mkparịta ụka nke na-emegide nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m1-b06-02.s.s1.r.b: A zara site na Yes. Ọ dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m1-b06-02.s.s1.r.c: A zara site na Yes. Ọ dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.

l-e-m1-b07-01.title: A na-eji an mgbe niile n’ihu a,e,i,o,u?
l-e-m1-b07-01.goal: Lelee ma iwu “jiri an mgbe niile tupu okwu malitere na mkpụrụedemede a,e,i,o,u” bụ eziokwu; chọta ma kọwaa ihe atụ megidere ya.
l-e-m1-b07-01.material: Echiche: Jiri an mgbe niile tupu okwu malitere na a,e,i,o,u. Chọta expression na-emegide ya.
l-e-m1-b07-01.s.s1.r.a: Ọ malitere na u, jiri an. Ihe atụ a dabara n’echiche.
l-e-m1-b07-01.s.s1.r.b: O jiri an, ọ bụghị a. Ihe atụ a dabara n’echiche.
l-e-m1-b07-01.s.s1.r.d: Ọ malitere na e, jiri an. Ihe atụ a dabara n’echiche.
l-e-m1-b07-01.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụ ezie na university malitere na u, ụda ya bụ “yoo”; ya mere jiri a. Họrọ a ma ọ bụ an site n’ụda mbụ, ọ bụghị mkpụrụedemede.
l-e-m1-b07-01.s.s2.model.0: a university malitere na u ma jiri a, ọ bụghị an; ya mere echiche ahụ ezighị ezi.
l-e-m1-b07-01.s.s2.model.1: Ụda mbụ nke university abụghị ụdaume, ọ na-ada “yoo”; ya mere jiri a, ọ bụ ihe atụ megidere echiche.

l-e-m1-b05-10.s.s1.r.b: Ajụjụ abụọ ahụ na-amalite na can, ya mere enweghị ike ịkewa ha n'ụzọ a.

l-e-m1-b06-10.goal: Kpebie ozi dị ezigbo mkpa iji mata ahịrịokwu zuru ezu na ìgwè okwu ndị ọzọ, kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-e-m1-b06-10.material: N'okpuru tebụl. / Pusi na-ehi ụra n'okpuru tebụl. Anyị chọrọ ịmata ma ha abụọ bụ ahịrịokwu zuru ezu.
l-e-m1-b06-10.s.s1.o.a: Ma o nwere isiokwu na ngwaa
l-e-m1-b06-10.s.s1.r.c: Ha abụọ malitere na mkpụrụedemede ukwu.
l-e-m1-b06-10.s.s1.r.d: ‘Dogs run.’ bụ ahịrịokwu zuru ezu n'agbanyeghị na ọ nwere okwu abụọ.
l-e-m1-b06-10.s.s1.explain: Ahịrịokwu zuru ezu chọrọ isiokwu (onye?) na ngwaa (na-eme gịnị?). ‘Under the table.’ enweghị nke ọ bụla.
l-e-m1-b06-10.s.s2.model.0: ‘The cat sleeps’ nwere isiokwu na ngwaa, ya mere ọ zuru ezu; ‘Under the table’ enweghị, ya mere ozi ahụ dị mkpa.
l-e-m1-b06-10.s.s2.model.1: Akara ntụpọ na mkpụrụedemede ukwu bụ otu n'ime ha abụọ, ya mere ha enweghị ike ikewa ha; anyị na-ekewa ha site n'ịma ma isiokwu na ngwaa dị.

l-e-m1-b07-06.thinking.1: Chee ma ozi ọ bụla dị mkpa n'ezie, otu n'otu.
l-e-m1-b07-06.thinking.2: Kọwaa iwu ndị zuru oke na ndị na-ezughị.
l-e-m1-b07-06.prereq.0: Nwere ike ikwu ihe ajụjụ ahụ na-ajụ.
l-e-m1-b07-06.prereq.1: Mara ihe okwu ndị ahụ pụtara.
l-e-m1-b07-06.s.s1.hint.0: Buru ụzọ dee n'otu ahịrịokwu ihe ajụjụ ahụ na-ajụ.
l-e-m1-b07-06.s.s1.hint.1: Maka nhọrọ nke ọ bụla, chee ma ozi ahụ naanị ya nwere ike ikpebi azịza.
l-e-m1-b07-06.s.s2.prompt: Dee ihe mere iwu ị họọrọ ji dị mkpa na ihe mere nhọrọ ndị ọzọ na-adịghị.
l-e-m1-b07-06.s.s2.hint.0: Kwuo ihe mere azịza ji doo anya mgbe i jiri iwu ahụ.
l-e-m1-b07-06.s.s2.hint.1: Kọwaa ihe mere otu nhọrọ ị jụghị ji ezughị ma ọ bụ na-adịghị mkpa.
l-e-m1-b07-06.s.s2.placeholder: Ihe atụ: Iwu a dị mkpa n'ihi na ... Nhọrọ ndị ọzọ ...
l-e-m1-b07-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị nyochara na iwu ị họọrọ naanị ya nwere ike ikpebi azịza?
l-e-m1-b07-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị tụlere ma ọ dịkarịa ala otu nhọrọ ị na-ahọrọghị?
l-e-m1-b07-06.title: Ọ ga-abụ -er ma ọ bụ more, ma gịnị ka ị ga-elele?
l-e-m1-b07-06.goal: Chọpụta ozi achọrọ n'ezie iji chọpụta otú e si eme ụdị atụnyere nke nkọwa, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara i ji họrọ ya.
l-e-m1-b07-06.material: A kewara nkọwa n'otu abụọ. Otu 1: strong, small, tall, fast. Otu 2: famous, boring, modern, useful. Ị chọrọ ikpebi ma ị ga-agbakwunye -er ma ọ bụ more.
l-e-m1-b07-06.s.s1.prompt: Kedu iwu kwesịrị ekwesị maka ikewa otu abụọ ahụ?
l-e-m1-b07-06.s.s1.o.a: Ọ nwere mkpụrụedemede 6 ma ọ bụ ihe pere mpe?
l-e-m1-b07-06.s.s1.r.a: strong na famous abụọ nwere mkpụrụedemede 6.
l-e-m1-b07-06.s.s1.o.b: Ọ nwere otu syllable, ma ọ bụ syllable abụọ ma ọ bụ karịa?
l-e-m1-b07-06.s.s1.o.c: Ihe ọ pụtara dị mma ma ọ bụ njọ?
l-e-m1-b07-06.s.s1.r.c: Otu 2 nwere ma useful (ihe ọ pụtara dị mma) ma boring (ihe ọ pụtara njọ).
l-e-m1-b07-06.s.s1.o.d: Ọ na-amalite site na mkpụrụedemede nke dị n'mmalite nke mkpụrụedemede?
l-e-m1-b07-06.s.s1.r.d: fast na famous abụọ na-amalite site na f.
l-e-m1-b07-06.s.s1.explain: Okwu otu syllable na-ewere -er, dị ka stronger, ma okwu nwere syllable abụọ ma ọ bụ karịa na-ewere more, dị ka more famous.
l-e-m1-b07-06.s.s2.model.0: Okwu nwere otu ụda na-ewere -er ma okwu nwere ụda abụọ ma ọ bụ karịa na-ewere more, ya mere ọnụọgụ syllable bụ iwu.
l-e-m1-b07-06.s.s2.model.1: Ọnụọgụ mkpụrụedemede ma ọ bụ mkpụrụedemede mbụ na-adakọ, dị ka strong na famous, ya mere ha enweghị ike ikewa otu ndị ahụ. Naanị ọnụọgụ syllable na-ekewa otu abụọ ahụ, ya mere ọ bụ iwu.

l-e-m1-b01-11.title: Mgbe this na-aghọ these
l-e-m1-b01-11.goal: Site n'ọtụtụ ikpe nke ịgbanwe this na that gaa n'udi plural ha, kwuo iwu, wee lelee iwu ahụ site n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-m1-b01-11.material: this cat → these cats, that bag → those bags, this pen → these pens, that egg → those eggs. Chọta iwu ahụ.
l-e-m1-b01-11.s.s1.o.a: Gaa n'ihu na-eji this·that ọbụna maka ihe karịrị otu
l-e-m1-b01-11.s.s1.r.a: Maka ihe karịrị otu, dị ka n'these cats, ị na-eji these.
l-e-m1-b01-11.s.s1.r.b: Maka otu, dị ka n'this cat, ị na-eji this.
l-e-m1-b01-11.s.s1.r.c: Ha nwere s, dị ka n'cats na bags.
l-e-m1-b01-11.s.s1.o.d: Maka otu, this·that; maka ihe karịrị otu, these·those
l-e-m1-b01-11.s.s1.explain: Maka ihe dị nso, otu bụ this ma ihe karịrị otu bụ these; maka ihe dị anya, otu bụ that ma ihe karịrị otu bụ those.
l-e-m1-b01-11.s.s2.model.0: This cat na-aghọ these cats ma that bag na-aghọ those bags, ya mere okwu ndị ahụ na-agbanwe dabere n'ọnụọgụ.
l-e-m1-b01-11.s.s2.model.1: Mgbe e nwere ihe karịrị otu, a na-agbakwunye s n'noun ma jiri these ma ọ bụ those, ya mere iwu bụ mgbanwe dabere n'ọnụọgụ.

l-e-m1-b02-12.s.s1.explain: Bugharịa can, are, will n'ihu isiokwu, tinye ? na njedebe.
l-e-m1-b02-12.s.s2.model.0: Can, are, will ga-abịa n'ihu isiokwu, ya mere iwu bụ ibuga okwu ndị ahụ n'ihu.

l-e-m1-b03-12.title: I na-aghọ me, they na-aghọkwa them
l-e-m1-b03-12.goal: Chọpụta ma kwuo iwu site n'ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke pronoun na-agbanwe mgbe ngwaa gasịrị, wee nwalee iwu ahụ n'ihe atụ ọhụrụ.
l-e-m1-b03-12.material: I help them. They help me. We help you. You help us. Tụnyere ụdị pronoun ndị ahụ.
l-e-m1-b03-12.s.s1.o.a: Mgbe ngwaa gasịrị ọ na-agbanwe ka ọ bụrụ me, us, them.
l-e-m1-b03-12.s.s1.o.b: Jiri me, us, them tupu ngwaa.
l-e-m1-b03-12.s.s1.r.b: Tupu ngwaa e nwere I, They, We, You.
l-e-m1-b03-12.s.s1.r.c: You ka bụ you mgbe ngwaa gasịrị kwa.
l-e-m1-b03-12.s.s1.o.d: Gaa n'ihu jiri I, we, they mgbe ngwaa gasịrị kwa.
l-e-m1-b03-12.s.s1.r.d: Mgbe ngwaa gasịrị e nwere me na them.
l-e-m1-b03-12.s.s1.explain: Ha na-agbanwe mgbe ngwaa gasịrị, dịka I → me, we → us, they → them. You anaghị agbanwe.
l-e-m1-b03-12.s.s2.model.0: Me, them na us na-abịa mgbe ngwaa gasịrị, ya mere iwu bụ na ụdị ahụ na-agbanwe.
l-e-m1-b03-12.s.s2.model.1: You ka bụ otu, ya mere ikwu na pronoun niile na-agbanwe ezighị ezi.

l-e-m1-b03-13.topic: Ụdị oge gara aga na-ejedebe na -ought
l-e-m1-b03-13.goal: Chọpụta ma kwuo iwu site n'ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke ụdị oge gara aga gbanwere ka ọ bụrụ -ought ma ọ bụ -aught, wee nwalee ya n'ihe atụ ọhụrụ.
l-e-m1-b03-13.material: buy → bought, bring → brought, think → thought, catch → caught. Tụnyere ụdị oge gara aga.
l-e-m1-b03-13.s.s1.o.a: Tinye -ed na ụdị ngwaa bụ isi.
l-e-m1-b03-13.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụ bought, ọ bụghị buyed.
l-e-m1-b03-13.s.s1.o.b: Ụdị oge gara aga bụ otu kpọmkwem na ụdị bụ isi.
l-e-m1-b03-13.s.s1.r.b: Buy na bought nwere ụdị dị iche.
l-e-m1-b03-13.s.s1.o.c: Ụdị oge gara aga na-ejedebe na -ought ma ọ bụ -aught.
l-e-m1-b03-13.s.s1.r.d: Njedebe ahụ na-agbanwe ka ọ bụrụ ihe dị ogologo dịka ought.
l-e-m1-b03-13.s.s1.explain: Ndị a bụ ngwaa na-agbasoghị iwu, njedebe ha na-agbanwe ka ọ bụrụ -ought ma ọ bụ -aught dịka buy → bought.
l-e-m1-b03-13.s.s2.model.0: Bought, brought, thought na caught niile na-ejedebe na ought ma ọ bụ aught, ya mere ụdị ahụ bụ iwu.
l-e-m1-b03-13.s.s2.model.1: Ọ dịghị otu ihe atụ nwere -ed agbakwunyere, ya mere were ya dịka mgbanwe na-adịghị agbaso iwu.

l-e-m1-b03-14.title: Iwu maka ụdị mkpirikpi dịka don't
l-e-m1-b03-14.goal: Chọpụta ma kwuo iwu site n'ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke ime not ka ọ dị mkpirikpi, wee nwalee iwu ahụ n'ihe atụ ọhụrụ.
l-e-m1-b03-14.material: do not → don't, is not → isn't, are not → aren't, does not → doesn't. Chọta iwu mkpirisi ahụ.
l-e-m1-b03-14.s.s1.o.a: Gbanwee n dị na not ka ọ bụrụ ' ma jikọta ya.
l-e-m1-b03-14.s.s1.o.b: Gbanwee o dị na not ka ọ bụrụ ' ma jikọta ya na okwu dị n'ihu.
l-e-m1-b03-14.s.s1.o.c: Wepụ mkpụrụedemede mbụ nke okwu mbụ.
l-e-m1-b03-14.s.s1.r.c: Mkpụrụedemede mbụ nke do na is ka dị otu.
l-e-m1-b03-14.s.s1.r.d: ' dị n'etiti n na t, ọ bụghị mgbe not gasịrị.
l-e-m1-b03-14.s.s1.explain: Gbanwee o dị na not ka ọ bụrụ akara apostrophe, jikọta ya na okwu dị n'ihu. is not → isn't.
l-e-m1-b03-14.s.s2.model.0: Ebe do not ghọrọ don't, iwu bụ na o na-agbanwe ka ọ bụrụ ' ma jikọta ya na okwu dị n'ihu.
l-e-m1-b03-14.s.s2.model.1: Ebe n na t ka dị, ị nwere ike ikwu na naanị o na-agbanwe ka ọ bụrụ akara apostrophe.

l-e-m1-b03-15.topic: The maka ihe pụrụ iche naanị ya
l-e-m1-b03-15.goal: Chọpụta ma kwuo iwu site n'ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke the tupu ihe pụrụ iche, wee nwalee ya n'ihe atụ ọhụrụ.
l-e-m1-b03-15.material: the sun, the moon, the earth, the sky / a cat, a book. Tụnyere okwu ndị na-eji the na ndị na-eji a.
l-e-m1-b03-15.s.s1.o.a: Jiri a maka ihe pụrụ iche kwa.
l-e-m1-b03-15.s.s1.r.a: Jiri the maka ihe pụrụ iche, dịka the sun.
l-e-m1-b03-15.s.s1.o.b: Jiri the maka ihe pụrụ iche, a maka otu n'ime ọtụtụ.
l-e-m1-b03-15.s.s1.o.c: Jiri the maka otu n'ime ọtụtụ kwa.
l-e-m1-b03-15.s.s1.r.c: Jiri a maka otu n'ime ọtụtụ, dịka a cat.
l-e-m1-b03-15.s.s1.o.d: A na the pụtara otu ihe, ya mere a pụrụ ịgbanwe ha.
l-e-m1-b03-15.s.s1.r.d: A naghị ekwu a sun maka anyanwụ.
l-e-m1-b03-15.s.s1.explain: Enwere naanị otu anyanwụ, ya mere ọ bụ the sun; e nwere ọtụtụ nwamba, ya mere a bụ a cat.
l-e-m1-b03-15.s.s2.model.0: Sun na moon bụ naanị otu n'ụdị ha, ya mere ha na-eji the; cat na book bụ otu n'ime ọtụtụ, ya mere ha na-eji a. Isi ihe bụ ma ọ bụ naanị otu.
l-e-m1-b03-15.s.s2.model.1: Ebe a naghị ekwu a sun maka anyanwụ, a na the enweghị ike ịgbanwe.

l-e-m1-b04-11.s.s1.r.a: rains na is abụghị ụdị past.
l-e-m1-b04-11.s.s1.o.b: Ọbụna maka ihe ga-eme n’ọdịnihu, jiri present n’enweghị will.
l-e-m1-b04-11.s.s1.r.c: Dịka X gosiri, will n’akụkụ if ezighị ezi.

l-e-m1-b05-14.title: Ime aha site na -ness
l-e-m1-b05-14.goal: Chọta ma kwuo iwu site n'ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke aha nwere -ness, wee lelee iwu ahụ site n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-m1-b05-14.material: happy → happiness, kind → kindness, dark → darkness, sad → sadness. Ha niile bụ aha e mere site na nkọwa.
l-e-m1-b05-14.s.s1.prompt: Site n'otu iwu ahụ, gịnị bụ aha e mere site na ill (ọrịa)?
l-e-m1-b05-14.s.s1.r.a: -ly bụ ọgwụgwụ na-eme okwu na-akọwa ngwaa. Iwu bụ -ness.
l-e-m1-b05-14.s.s1.r.c: -ment bụ iwu dị iche. Ihe atụ ndị ahụ niile na-eji -ness.
l-e-m1-b05-14.s.s1.r.d: -ful bụ iwu dị iche. Ihe atụ ndị ahụ niile na-eji -ness.
l-e-m1-b05-14.s.s1.explain: Gbakwunye -ness mgbe nkọwa iji mee aha. ill + ness = illness (ọrịa, ọrịa).
l-e-m1-b05-14.s.s2.model.0: Okwu anọ ahụ niile na-agbakwunye -ness mgbe nkọwa, ya mere ill na-aghọkwa illness.
l-e-m1-b05-14.s.s2.model.1: Kind na-aghọ kindness ma sad na-aghọ sadness, ya mere iji otu iwu ahụ na ill na-enye illness.

l-e-m1-b05-15.goal: Chọta ma kwuo iwu site n'ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke prefixes na-eme mmegide, wee lelee iwu ahụ site n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-m1-b05-15.s.s1.prompt: Gịnị bụ mmegide nke perfect site n'otu iwu ahụ?
l-e-m1-b05-15.s.s1.r.b: Ihe atụ ndị ahụ na-eji in ma ọ bụ im, ọ bụghị dis.
l-e-m1-b05-15.s.s1.r.c: Tupu p, jiri im, ọ bụghị in (polite → impolite).
l-e-m1-b05-15.s.s1.r.d: Ihe atụ ndị ahụ na-eji in ma ọ bụ im, ọ bụghị un.
l-e-m1-b05-15.s.s1.explain: Gbakwunye im- tupu okwu na-amalite site na p, na in- n'ụzọ ọzọ. Perfect na-amalite site na p, ya mere ọ na-aghọ imperfect.
l-e-m1-b05-15.s.s2.model.0: Dị ka polite na possible, okwu na-amalite site na p na-ewere im-, ya mere perfect na-aghọkwa imperfect.
l-e-m1-b05-15.s.s2.model.1: Active na correct na-ewere in-, ma okwu na-amalite site na p na-ewere im-, ya mere perfect bụ imperfect.

l-e-m1-b06-11.s.s1.r.a: Enweghị did n'ihe atụ ndị ahụ.

l-e-m1-b06-11.s.s1.explain: A na-eji was/were + ngwaa-ing ekwu ihe na-aga n'ihu n'oge ụfọdụ gara aga. Họrọ was ma ọ bụ were dabere n'isiokwu.
l-e-m1-b06-11.s.s2.model.0: Ihe atụ anọ niile ji ngwaa-ing mgbe was ma ọ bụ were gasịrị, ya mere ụdị ahụ bụ iwu.
l-e-m1-b06-11.s.s2.model.1: I na Sam na-eji was, We na They na-eji were, ha niile na-agbakwunye -ing, ya mere iwu bụ was/were + -ing.

l-e-m1-b07-02.title: Olee mgbe e ji otu apostrophe maka ’s?
l-e-m1-b07-02.goal: Lee ọtụtụ ihe atụ nwe dịka the dog’s bowl, kwuo iwu ị hụrụ, nwalee ya n’ọnọdụ ọhụrụ.
l-e-m1-b07-02.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ iwu dabara n’ihe atụ anọ niile.
l-e-m1-b07-02.s.s1.o.b: Ọ bụrụ na ọ naghị akwụsị na -s, tinye ’s; ọ bụrụ na ọ kwụsị na -s, tinye naanị apostrophe.
l-e-m1-b07-02.s.s1.r.c: dogs’ bụ ọtụtụ, ma e tinyere naanị apostrophe.
l-e-m1-b07-02.s.s1.o.d: Hapụ singular otu ahụ, tinye ’s naanị na plural.
l-e-m1-b07-02.s.s1.explain: dog’s, child’s, children’s anaghị akwụsị na -s, ha na-ewere ’s; dogs akwụsịlarị na -s, ya mere naanị apostrophe.
l-e-m1-b07-02.s.s2.model.0: dog’s, child’s, children’s ji ’s; dogs’ ji naanị apostrophe; ihe dị mkpa bụ ma okwu ahụ kwụsịrị na -s.

l-e-m1-b01-16.material: Akwụkwọ akụkọ English nwere isi 7, ma isi ọ bụla bụ ihe dị ka peeji 9.

l-e-m1-b01-16.s.s1.r.c: Nke ahụ bụ ihe dị ka peeji 85 maka isi ọ bụla, nke dị ọtụtụ nke ukwuu.

l-e-m1-b01-18.s.s1.r.c: Nke ahụ bụ ihe dị ka akwụkwọ 125 maka ngalaba ọ bụla, nke dị ọtụtụ nke ukwuu.

l-e-m1-b03-17.s.s1.r.b: Nke a bụ ihe dị ka okwu 1,200 n'otu peeji, nke karịrị akarị.

l-e-m1-b03-17.s.s2.model.0: Peeji 48 nwere okwu 120 nke ọ bụla bụ ihe dị ka 5,760, ya mere ihe dị ka okwu 6,000.

l-e-m1-b03-18.s.s1.explain: 60÷5=12, ya mere e nwere ihe dị ka okwu 12 n'otu ahịrịokwu.
l-e-m1-b03-18.s.s2.model.0: Ikesa okwu 60 n'ahịrịokwu 5 na-enye 12 n'otu nke ọ bụla, ya mere ihe dị ka okwu 12.

l-e-m1-b04-17.s.s1.r.c: Awa 2 bụ oge ije ihe dị ka 8km. Ọ dị ogologo nke ukwuu.
l-e-m1-b04-17.s.s1.r.d: Nke a dị nso n’oge ije 4km. 800m dị mkpụmkpụ nke ukwuu.

l-e-m1-b04-17.s.s2.model.0: 800m bụ 1/5 nke 4,000m; ya mere ọ ga-ewe nkeji 12, nke bụ 1/5 nke nkeji 60.
l-e-m1-b04-17.s.s2.model.1: N’ime awa 1 a na-aga 4,000m; 800m bụ 1/5 ya, ya bụ ihe dị ka nkeji 12.

l-e-m1-b05-19.title: Ịtụ anya ma peeji dị mfe ịgụ
l-e-m1-b05-19.goal: Tụọ anya ma enwere ike ịgụ peeji n'ụzọ dị mma iji kpebie nha ma ọ bụ ókè kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-m1-b05-19.material: Peeji nwere ihe dị ka okwu 200 ma Taylor amaghị 20 n'ime ha. Ọ bụrụ na onye na-agụ maara 95% ma ọ bụ karịa nke okwu ndị ahụ, peeji ahụ dị mma ịgụ.
l-e-m1-b05-19.s.s1.prompt: Taylor nwere ike ịgụ peeji a n'ụzọ dị mma?

l-e-m1-b05-19.s.s1.r.a: Ị ga-ekpebi site na pasent nke ihe dum, ọ bụghị site n'ọnụọgụ.
l-e-m1-b05-19.s.s1.o.b: Enweghị ike ịgụ ya. Ihe dị ka 10% nke okwu ka a maara
l-e-m1-b05-19.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụghị na a maara 10% nke okwu; 10% nke okwu ka amaghị.
l-e-m1-b05-19.s.s1.o.c: Ntakịrị siri ike. Ihe dị ka 90% nke okwu ka a maara
l-e-m1-b05-19.s.s1.o.d: Dị mfe nke ukwuu. Ihe dị ka 99% nke okwu ka a maara
l-e-m1-b05-19.s.s1.r.d: Okwu ndị amaghị bụ 10% nke 200, ya mere okwu ndị a maara bụ 90%.
l-e-m1-b05-19.s.s1.explain: 20 bụ 10% nke 200, ya mere ihe dị ka 90% nke okwu ka a maara. Nke ahụ dị n'okpuru 95%, ya mere peeji ahụ siri ike ntakịrị.
l-e-m1-b05-19.s.s2.model.0: 20 bụ 10% nke 200, ya mere ihe dị ka 90% nke okwu ka a maara, nke dị n'okpuru 95%.

l-e-m1-b06-19.s.s1.explain: 2.10×3=6.30 na 2.90×3=8.70, ya mere ngụkọta dị n'etiti ihe dị ka $6 na $9.

l-e-m1-b07-05.title: Ole ihe e dere n'akwụkwọ ọkọwa okwu?
l-e-m1-b07-05.goal: Tụọ anya ọnụọgụ ihe e dere n'otu akwụkwọ ọkọwa okwu Bekee, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ ókè kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara.
l-e-m1-b07-05.material: Otu akwụkwọ ọkọwa okwu Bekee nwere peeji 480, na ihe dị ka ihe e dere 25 n'peeji ọ bụla. Tụọ anya ọnụọgụ ihe e dere n'akwụkwọ dum.
l-e-m1-b07-05.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ntụ anya kwesịrị ekwesị nke ọnụọgụ dum nke ihe e dere?
l-e-m1-b07-05.s.s1.r.b: Ọ na-agụ naanị peeji ma ọ naghị amụba site n'ọnụọgụ ihe e dere n'peeji ọ bụla.
l-e-m1-b07-05.s.s1.r.c: Ọ buru ibu ihe dị ka ugboro iri. Ọ na-ewere peeji ọ bụla dị ka nwere ihe e dere 250.
l-e-m1-b07-05.s.s1.r.d: Ọ pere mpe ihe dị ka ugboro iri. Ọ na-ewere peeji ọ bụla dị ka nwere ihe e dere 2.5.
l-e-m1-b07-05.s.s1.explain: Iwere peeji 480 dị ka peeji 500 na-enye 500×25=12,500, ya mere ihe dị ka 12,000 kwesịrị ekwesị.
l-e-m1-b07-05.s.s2.model.0: Na ihe dị ka peeji 500 na ihe e dere 25 nke ọ bụla, 500×25=12,500, ya mere ihe dị ka 12,000 kwesịrị ekwesị.
l-e-m1-b07-05.s.s2.model.1: 480×25=12,000, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka 12,000. 1,200 na 120,000 adịghị mma n'ihi na ha nwere ọnụọgụ ọnụọgụ dị iche.

l-e-m1-b01-21.title: Who's bag? Ebee ka ọ nwere njehie?
l-e-m1-b01-21.goal: Soro, nzọụkwụ site n'nzọụkwụ, ngwọta gbasara ịjụ onye nwe akpa, ma ọ bụ njikọ ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, chọta ebe mbụ ọ na-adighị mma, ma dozie ya.
l-e-m1-b01-21.material: Nke a bụ ngwọta maka idee 'Whose bag is this?' ① Ọ bụ ajụjụ na-ajụ gbasara onye nwe ② Who's bụ nkenke nke Who is ③ Ịjụ gbasara onye nwe, ya mere jiri Who's ④ Emechara: Who's bag is this?
l-e-m1-b01-21.s.s1.o.a: ① Ọ bụ ajụjụ na-ajụ gbasara onye nwe
l-e-m1-b01-21.s.s1.r.a: Ọ ziri ezi n'ihi na ọ bụ ahịrịokwu na-ajụ 'whose'.
l-e-m1-b01-21.s.s1.o.b: ② Who's bụ nkenke nke Who is
l-e-m1-b01-21.s.s1.r.b: Nkọwa nke udi nkenke ahụ ziri ezi.
l-e-m1-b01-21.s.s1.o.c: ③ Ịjụ gbasara onye nwe, ya mere jiri Who's
l-e-m1-b01-21.s.s1.o.d: ④ Emechara: Who's bag is this?
l-e-m1-b01-21.s.s1.explain: Mgbe ị na-ajụ gbasara onye nwe, ị na-eji Whose. Whose bag is this? ziri ezi.
l-e-m1-b01-21.s.s2.model.0: Who's pụtara Who is, ya mere ọ pụghị ịjụ gbasara onye nwe, nke pụtara na ③ kwesịrị ịbụ Whose.
l-e-m1-b01-21.s.s2.model.1: N'ihi na ② kwuru na Who's bụ Who is, ị ga-eji Whose maka 'whose'.

l-e-m1-b01-22.s.s2.model.1: N'ihi na three cats bụ plural, a ga-edozi ya ka ọ bụrụ are, ọ bụghị is.

l-e-m1-b01-25.goal: Soro ngwọta nke jikọtara ahịrịokwu abụọ site na but, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, otu nzọụkwụ n'otu oge; chọta ebe mbụ ọ na-adighị mma ma dozie ya.

l-e-m1-b01-25.s.s1.r.a: Ziri ezi, n'ihi na ahịrịokwu mbụ na-ekwu na mmiri gbara.
l-e-m1-b01-25.s.s1.r.b: Ziri ezi, n'ihi na ahịrịokwu nke abụọ na-ekwu na ha nọ n'ụlọ.
l-e-m1-b01-25.s.s1.o.c: ③ Ahịrịokwu abụọ ahụ nwere ihe pụtara na-emegiderịta onwe ha, ya mere jiri but
l-e-m1-b01-25.s.s1.o.d: ④ Ikpeazụ: ... but we stayed home.
l-e-m1-b01-25.s.s1.explain: Ha nọrọ n'ụlọ n'ihi mmiri, ya mere ọ bụ ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ. It was raining, so we stayed home. ziri ezi.
l-e-m1-b01-25.s.s2.model.0: Mmiri bụ ihe kpatara ịnọ n'ụlọ, ya mere a ga-ejikọta ahịrịokwu ahụ na so, ọ bụghị dị ka ihe megidere, nke na-eme ③ adịghị mma.
l-e-m1-b01-25.s.s2.model.1: but na-ejikọta ihe pụtara na-emegiderịta onwe ha, ya mere so ziri ezi maka ahịrịokwu abụọ a, nke na-egosi ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ.

l-e-m1-b02-24.title: Awa ole ka ọba akwụkwọ na-emeghe?
l-e-m1-b02-24.goal: Soro ngụkọta oge ọba akwụkwọ na-emeghe nzọụkwụ ruo nzọụkwụ, chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ njehie dị.
l-e-m1-b02-24.material: Ọkwa ọkwa: Ọba akwụkwọ na-emeghe site na 9 a.m. ruo 6 p.m. Ngụkọta: ① 9 a.m. bụ ụtụtụ, 6 p.m. bụ mgbede ② 6 p.m. bụ elekere 18 ③ 18-9=6, ya mere ọ na-emeghe awa 6 ④ Azịza: awa 6. (9, 9, 9; 6, 6, 6, 6, 6, 6)
l-e-m1-b02-24.s.s1.r.a: A gụrụ oge ndị ahụ nke ọma.
l-e-m1-b02-24.s.s1.r.b: Nke ahụ ziri ezi, n'ihi na 6 p.m. bụ elekere 18.
l-e-m1-b02-24.s.s1.o.c: ③ 18-9=6, ya mere ọ na-emeghe awa 6.
l-e-m1-b02-24.s.s2.model.0: 18 wepụ 9 bụ 9, ọ bụghị 6, ya mere ③ ezighi ezi.
l-e-m1-b02-24.s.s2.model.1: Site na 9 a.m. ruo 6 p.m. bụ awa 9, ya mere azịza bụ awa 9.

l-e-m1-b05-23.title: Ebe akụkọ nkịta na-apụ n'isiokwu
l-e-m1-b05-23.goal: Soro nzọụkwụ nke echiche, ma ọ bụ agbụ ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, gbasara isiokwu nke paragraf, iji chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ ọ na-aga ezighi ezi.
l-e-m1-b05-23.material: Ahịrị okwu isiokwu: Dogs are good pets. Echiche: ① Dogs keep people company as friends. ② Dogs make people go for walks, which helps their health. ③ Cats sleep for a long time each day. ④ So dogs are good pets.
l-e-m1-b05-23.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nzọụkwụ bụ nke mbụ pụrụ n'isiokwu?

l-e-m1-b05-23.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụ ihe kpatara nkịta ji bụrụ anụ ụlọ ọma, ya mere ọ dabara.
l-e-m1-b05-23.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụ ihe kpatara nkịta ji bụrụ anụ ụlọ ọma, ya mere ọ dabara.
l-e-m1-b05-23.s.s1.o.b: ② Dogs make people go for walks, which helps their health
l-e-m1-b05-23.s.s1.o.c: ③ Cats sleep for a long time each day
l-e-m1-b05-23.s.s1.o.d: ④ So dogs are good pets
l-e-m1-b05-23.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ nkwupụta mmechi nke ahịrị okwu isiokwu, ya mere ọ dabara.
l-e-m1-b05-23.s.s1.explain: ③ gbasara nwamba, ya mere ọ naghị akwado isiokwu na nkịta bụ anụ ụlọ ọma.
l-e-m1-b05-23.s.s2.model.0: ③ na-ekwu banyere nwamba, ya mere ọ nweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na isiokwu na nkịta bụ anụ ụlọ ọma.
l-e-m1-b05-23.s.s2.model.1: Isiokwu bụ nkịta, ma naanị ③ gbasara nwamba, ya mere ọ bụ ebe mbụ pụrụ n'isiokwu.

l-e-m1-b05-24.goal: Soro nzọụkwụ nke echiche, ma ọ bụ agbụ ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, n'ọkwa nwere if, iji chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ ọ na-aga ezighi ezi.
l-e-m1-b05-24.material: Ọkwa ahụ: If it rains, the class is canceled. Echiche: ① If it rains, the class is canceled. ② It rained on Monday. ③ So Monday's class is canceled. ④ So Tuesday's class is canceled too.

l-e-m1-b05-24.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụ kpọmkwem ihe dị n'ọkwa ahụ.

l-e-m1-b05-24.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ klaas nke ụbọchị mmiri zoro; ya mere ọ ziri ezi.
l-e-m1-b05-24.s.s1.explain: Ọkwa ahụ kagburu naanị klaas n’ụbọchị mmiri zoro. Amaghị ma mmiri zoro Tuesday.
l-e-m1-b05-24.s.s2.model.0: Naanị ụbọchị mmiri zoro bụ Monday; ya mere ④ nke kwuru na a kagburu klaas Tuesday kwa bụ njehie mbụ.

l-e-m1-b05-25.topic: Ịhọrọ ihe okwu pụtara site n’ọnọdụ
l-e-m1-b05-25.goal: Soro usoro echiche ịhọrọ ihe okwu pụtara ma chọta njehie mbụ.
l-e-m1-b05-25.material: Anyị nọdụrụ n’akụkụ bank lelee mmiri. bank: Usoro ịhọrọ ihe ọ pụtara: ① Bank nwere ihe abụọ ọ pụtara, ebe ego na akụkụ osimiri. ② N’ahịrịokwu ahụ, ha nọdụrụ lelee mmiri. ③ A pụkwara ịnọdụ lelee mmiri n’ebe ego dị; ya mere ihe pụtara ebe ego dabara. ④ Ya mere “Anyị nọdụrụ n’elu ebe ego.”
l-e-m1-b05-25.s.s1.o.a: ① Bank nwere ihe abụọ ọ pụtara.
l-e-m1-b05-25.s.s1.r.a: Bank pụtara ma ebe ego ma akụkụ osimiri; nke a ziri ezi.
l-e-m1-b05-25.s.s1.o.b: ③ Ị nwere ike ile mmiri na bank, ya mere ọ bụ ebe ego.
l-e-m1-b05-25.s.s1.r.d: Nkọwa ahụ ezighị ezi, ma ihe kpatara ya bụ ③ bu ya ụzọ.
l-e-m1-b05-25.s.s1.explain: Ebe a na-anọdụ lelee mmiri bụ akụkụ osimiri. Okwu water n’ahịrịokwu ahụ bụ akara na ọ bụ akụkụ osimiri.
l-e-m1-b05-25.s.s2.model.0: Water na sat on na-ezo aka n’akụkụ osimiri; ya mere ịhọrọ ebe ego na ③ ezighị ezi.
l-e-m1-b05-25.s.s2.model.1: Ebe a ga-anọdụ lelee mmiri bụ akụkụ osimiri; ya mere ③ nke họọrọ ebe ego bụ ebe mbụ njehie dị.

l-e-m1-b06-21.title: Ihe "Neither do I" pụtara: ebee ka ọ gbagwojuru?
l-e-m1-b06-21.goal: Soro nzọụkwụ nke ịchọpụta ihe "Neither do I" pụtara, ma ọ bụ usoro site na ihe kpatara ruo nsonaazụ, otu n'otu, chọta ebe mbụ ọ gbagwojuru ma rụzie ya.
l-e-m1-b06-21.material: A: I don't like fish. B: Neither do I. Nzọụkwụ maka ịkọwa mkparịta ụka: ① A anaghị ahụ azụ n'anya. ② Neither pụtara "ihe megidere A." ③ Ya mere B hụrụ azụ n'anya. ④ Ndị abụọ ahụ na-eche echiche dị iche.
l-e-m1-b06-21.s.s1.o.b: ① A anaghị ahụ azụ n'anya
l-e-m1-b06-21.s.s1.r.b: Nke ahụ bụ ihe I don't like fish pụtara, ya mere ọ ziri ezi.
l-e-m1-b06-21.s.s1.o.c: ③ Ya mere B hụrụ azụ n'anya
l-e-m1-b06-21.s.s1.r.c: Nkwubi okwu ezighị ezi, mana ihe kpatara bụ ② nke bu ya ụzọ.
l-e-m1-b06-21.s.s1.r.d: Nkwubi okwu ezighị ezi, mana ihe kpatara bụ ② nke bu ya ụzọ.
l-e-m1-b06-21.s.s1.o.d: ④ Ndị abụọ ahụ na-eche echiche dị iche
l-e-m1-b06-21.s.s1.explain: "Neither do I" pụtara "Anaghị m ahụ ya n'anya kwa." B anaghị ahụ azụ n'anya kwa.
l-e-m1-b06-21.s.s2.model.0: "Neither do I" pụtara "Anaghị m ahụ ya n'anya kwa," ya mere ②, nke kwuru "ihe megidere," bụ njehie mbụ.
l-e-m1-b06-21.s.s2.model.1: Ọ kwekọrọ n'ihe A na-ahụghị n'anya, ya mere B anaghị ahụ azụ n'anya kwa, ② bụkwa ebe ọ gbagwojuru.

l-e-m1-b06-23.title: Ebee ka ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ agwakọtara?
l-e-m1-b06-23.goal: Soro nzọụkwụ nke ịchọpụta ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ n'ederede, ma ọ bụ usoro site na ihe kpatara ruo nsonaazụ, otu n'otu, chọta ebe mbụ ọ gbagwojuru ma rụzie ya.
l-e-m1-b06-23.material: Ederede: The road was wet because it rained. Cars drove slowly. Nzọụkwụ: ① Ihe kpatara okporo ụzọ ịdị mmiri bụ na mmiri zoro. ② Ụgbọ ala gbara ọsọ nwayọọ. ③ Ya mere ụgbọ ala gbara ọsọ nwayọọ okporo ụzọ ahụ wee bụrụ mmiri. ④ Nsonaazụ ghọrọ ihe kpatara.
l-e-m1-b06-23.s.s1.o.a: ① Ihe kpatara okporo ụzọ mmiri bụ mmiri ozuzo
l-e-m1-b06-23.s.s1.r.a: Ederede ahụ na-ekwu because it rained.
l-e-m1-b06-23.s.s1.o.b: ② Ụgbọ ala gbara ọsọ nwayọọ
l-e-m1-b06-23.s.s1.r.b: Ederede ahụ na-ekwu nke a kpọmkwem.
l-e-m1-b06-23.s.s1.o.c: ③ Ụgbọ ala gbara ọsọ nwayọọ, ya mere okporo ụzọ ghọrọ mmiri
l-e-m1-b06-23.s.s1.r.d: Ọ na-achịkọta nkwupụta na-ezighị ezi, ihe kpatara bụkwa ③ nke bu ya ụzọ.
l-e-m1-b06-23.s.s1.explain: Okporo ụzọ dị mmiri n'ihi mmiri ozuzo. Ụgbọ ala na-agba ọsọ nwayọọ nwere ike jikọtara na okporo ụzọ mmiri, mana ọ bụghị ihe mere okporo ụzọ ji dị mmiri.
l-e-m1-b06-23.s.s2.model.0: Ụgbọ ala na-agba ọsọ nwayọọ bụ nsonaazụ, ya mere ③, nke kpọrọ ya ihe kpatara okporo ụzọ mmiri, ezighị ezi.
l-e-m1-b06-23.s.s2.model.1: Ihe kpatara n'ederede ahụ bụ mmiri ozuzo, ya mere ọ gbagwojuru mbụ n'③, nke mere ịgba ọsọ nwayọọ ihe kpatara.

l-e-m1-b04-31.material: Ahịrịokwu abụọ gbasara ihe e mere taa. A: I did many things today. B: I played soccer and made a cake today.
l-e-m1-b04-31.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nke dabara adaba karịa dị ka ahịrịokwu akwụkwọ ndụ?
l-e-m1-b04-31.s.s1.o.a: B. Enwere ike ịhụ ihe e mere n'ụzọ doro anya
l-e-m1-b04-31.s.s1.o.b: A. Ọ dị mkpụmkpụ, ya mere ọ dị mfe ide
l-e-m1-b04-31.s.s1.r.b: Ọbụlagodi na ọ dị mkpụmkpụ, ị pụghị ịmata ihe e mere.
l-e-m1-b04-31.s.s1.r.c: Ọbụlagodi na ọ na-agụnye ihe niile, ọ bụghị nke doro anya.
l-e-m1-b04-31.s.s1.o.d: Ha abụọ bụ otu. Ha abụọ bụ ihe e mere taa
l-e-m1-b04-31.s.s1.r.d: B dị mma karịa n'ihi na ị nwere ike ịmata ihe e mere.
l-e-m1-b04-31.s.s1.explain: N'akwụkwọ ndụ, ị kwesịrị ide n'ụzọ doro anya ihe i mere, ka onye na-agụ nwee ike ịhụ ọnọdụ ahụ n'echiche.
l-e-m1-b04-31.s.s2.model.0: B na-egosi ihe doro anya, soccer na cake, ya mere ọ dabara adaba karịa dị ka ahịrịokwu akwụkwọ ndụ.
l-e-m1-b04-31.s.s2.model.1: A na-ekwu ọtụtụ ihe, ya mere ị pụghị ịmata ihe e mere. B, ebe a na-ahụ ihe e mere, dị mma karịa.

l-e-m1-b04-32.title: Ịtụnyere echiche maka ihe chilly pụtara
l-e-m1-b04-32.topic: Ichee ihe okwu pụtara site n'ọnọdụ
l-e-m1-b04-32.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ abụọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ gbasara ichee ihe okwu amaghị pụtara, họrọ nke dabara adaba karịa, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-m1-b04-32.material: It was so chilly that Sam put on a coat. Nwa akwụkwọ 1: chilly pụtara 'ọkụ'. Ọ dị ka okwu nwere mmetụta ọma. Nwa akwụkwọ 2: Ọ pụtara 'oyi', n'ihi na Sam yi uwe mwụda.
l-e-m1-b04-32.s.s1.prompt: Kedu echiche nwere ihe akaebe karịa?
l-e-m1-b04-32.s.s1.o.a: Nwa akwụkwọ 2. Ihe ngosi dị: iyi uwe mwụda
l-e-m1-b04-32.s.s1.o.b: Nwa akwụkwọ 1. Ọ dị ka okwu nwere mmetụta ọma
l-e-m1-b04-32.s.s1.r.b: Mmetụta nke okwu abụghị ihe akaebe. Ị chọrọ ihe ngosi n'ahịrịokwu ahụ.
l-e-m1-b04-32.s.s1.o.c: Ha abụọ ziri ezi. Ha bụ echiche, ya mere ha bụ otu
l-e-m1-b04-32.s.s1.r.c: Echiche na-adị nkwenye karịa mgbe o nwere ihe ngosi.
l-e-m1-b04-32.s.s1.o.d: Ha abụọ na-ezighị ezi. Enweghị dictionary
l-e-m1-b04-32.s.s1.r.d: Ọbụlagodi na-enweghị dictionary, ị nwere ike iche echiche site n'ihe ngosi ọnọdụ.
l-e-m1-b04-32.s.s1.explain: Ihe ngosi dị n'ahịrịokwu ahụ: iyi uwe mwụda. Ọ bụrụ na ọ dị ọkụ, ọ gaghị enwe ihe kpatara iyi uwe mwụda.
l-e-m1-b04-32.s.s2.model.0: Sam yi uwe mwụda, ya mere ihe ngosi dị na ọ dị oyi, mana echiche na ọ pụtara ọkụ enweghị ihe ngosi.
l-e-m1-b04-32.s.s2.model.1: Nwa akwụkwọ 2 na-eji ihe ngosi dị n'ahịrịokwu, ya mere o nwere ihe akaebe. Nwa akwụkwọ 1 na-ekwu naanị banyere mmetụta, ya mere o siri ike ịtụkwasị obi.

l-e-m1-b04-33.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ abụọ nke ime omume ịgụ Bekee, họrọ nke dabara adaba karịa, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-m1-b04-33.material: Ị chọrọ ịmefu nkeji 70 n'izu n'ịgụ Bekee. Ụzọ A: gụọ nkeji 10 kwa ụbọchị. Ụzọ B: gụọ nkeji 70 n'otu oge na Sunday.
l-e-m1-b04-33.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ụzọ dị mma karịa maka icheta?
l-e-m1-b04-33.s.s1.o.a: B. Ị na-elekwasị anya mgbe ị na-eme ya ogologo oge n'otu oge
l-e-m1-b04-33.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụrụ na ị na-eme ya ogologo oge, ike na-agwụ gị, ị pụghịkwa ịhụ ya ọzọ n'ime izu.
l-e-m1-b04-33.s.s1.o.b: B. Ọ bụ otu ugboro n'izu, ya mere ọ dị mfe
l-e-m1-b04-33.s.s1.r.b: Ịdị mfe na icheta bụ ihe dị iche.
l-e-m1-b04-33.s.s1.o.c: Ha abụọ bụ otu. Ngụkọta oge bụ otu
l-e-m1-b04-33.s.s1.r.c: Ọbụlagodi na oge bụ otu, ọnụọgụ ugboro ị na-ezute ya dị iche, ya mere ebe nchekwa dị iche.
l-e-m1-b04-33.s.s1.o.d: A. Ị na-ezute ya ugboro ugboro, ya mere ebe nchekwa gị na-aga n'ihu
l-e-m1-b04-33.s.s1.explain: Ọbụlagodi na ngụkọta oge bụ otu, ịzute ya kwa ụbọchị pụtara na ị na-ahụ ya ọzọ tupu ichefu, ya mere ọ na-anọ n'ebe nchekwa ogologo oge.
l-e-m1-b04-33.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na ị gụọ kwa ụbọchị, ị na-ahụ ya ọzọ tupu ichefu, ya mere ọ na-anọ n'ebe nchekwa ogologo oge, nke na-eme A dabara adaba.
l-e-m1-b04-33.s.s2.model.1: B nwere ọtụtụ ụbọchị n'izu na-enweghị ịgụ, ya mere o dị mfe ichefu, nke na-eme A dị mma karịa ọbụlagodi na ngụkọta oge bụ otu.

l-e-m1-b04-34.title: Ịtụnyere ụzọ icheta irregular past tenses
l-e-m1-b04-34.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ abụọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ gbasara icheta irregular past tenses, họrọ nke dabara adaba karịa, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-m1-b04-34.material: Ụzọ A: cheta sang, swam, drank otu n'otu, n'iche. Ụzọ B: cheta sing-sang, ring-rang, swim-swam, drink-drank dị ka ìgwè i→a. Ị zutere ngwaa ọhụrụ, begin.
l-e-m1-b04-34.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ụzọ dị mma karịa maka ịchọpụta past tense nke begin?
l-e-m1-b04-34.s.s1.o.a: A. Icheta otu n'otu dị nkenke karịa
l-e-m1-b04-34.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụrụ na begin anọghị n'ndepụta ị chetara n'iche, ị pụghị ịmata.
l-e-m1-b04-34.s.s1.o.b: Ọ nweghị nke nwere ike iji maka begin
l-e-m1-b04-34.s.s1.r.b: B nwere ike itinye iwu ahụ na begin ma chee began.
l-e-m1-b04-34.s.s1.o.c: B. Ọ bụrụ na ị kpọkọta ha site n'iwu, ị nwere ike iji ya na okwu ọhụrụ
l-e-m1-b04-34.s.s1.o.d: A. Ọ bụrụ na ị na-ekwughachi ọtụtụ, ị naghị achọ iwu
l-e-m1-b04-34.s.s1.r.d: Ọbụlagodi na ịkwughachi, ị pụghị ịchọpụta okwu ndị na-anọghị n'ndepụta.
l-e-m1-b04-34.s.s1.explain: B nwere ike iche begin → began site n'iwu i→a. A maara naanị okwu o chetara.
l-e-m1-b04-34.s.s2.model.0: B maara iwu ahụ, ya mere ọ nwere ike iji ya ọbụna na begin, nke ọ na-ahụ nke mbụ, ya mere ọ dabara adaba karịa.
l-e-m1-b04-34.s.s2.model.1: A enweghị ike iji ya na okwu ndị na-anọghị n'ndepụta, mana B na-etinye iwu ahụ, ya mere ọ nwere ike ịchọpụta begin → began.

l-e-m1-b05-31.goal: Tụlee ụzọ abụọ e si ede ihe mgbe a na-ege ntị, họrọ nke ka mma ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-m1-b05-31.material: Ị chọrọ ide ihe ị nụrụ. Ụzọ A: Dee ahịrịokwu zuru oke kpọmkwem ka ị nụrụ. Ụzọ B: Dee naanị isi okwu nkenke.
l-e-m1-b05-31.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ụzọ ka mma maka ide ihe mgbe a na-ege ntị?
l-e-m1-b05-31.s.s1.o.a: B. Dee naanị isi ihe ka ị ghara ịhapụ ihe ga-eso.
l-e-m1-b05-31.s.s1.o.b: A. Ọ dị mma n’ihi na ị nwere ike ide ihe niile n’enweghị ihe efu.
l-e-m1-b05-31.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụrụ na i dee ahịrịokwu niile, ị ga-atụfu ihe na-esote.
l-e-m1-b05-31.s.s1.o.c: A. Ahịrịokwu ga-ezu oke ka e wee gụọ ya ma emechaa.
l-e-m1-b05-31.s.s1.r.c: Site n’isi okwu, ị nwere ike gụọ ha ma cheta.
l-e-m1-b05-31.s.s1.o.d: Ha bụ otu; naanị ọnụọgụ ihe e dere dị iche.
l-e-m1-b05-31.s.s1.r.d: Ọnụọgụ ihe e dere dị iche; ya mere ọnụọgụ okwu a tụfuru dịkwa iche.
l-e-m1-b05-31.s.s1.explain: Okwu na-aga n’ihu. Ọ bụrụ na ị dee naanị isi okwu, ị gaghị atụfu ihe na-esote, ị ga-echetakwa ya ma emechaa.
l-e-m1-b05-31.s.s2.model.0: Ide ahịrịokwu niile agaghị eso ọsọ ige ntị; ya mere B nke dere naanị isi ihe ka mma.
l-e-m1-b05-31.s.s2.model.1: B dere nkenke; ya mere ị nwere ike ịnọgide na-ege ntị ma chefuo obere ihe.

l-e-m1-b05-32.goal: Tụlee ụzọ abụọ e si arịọ mmadụ ikwughachi, họrọ nke ka mma ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-m1-b05-32.material: Ị ghọtaghị okwu enyi gị. A: What? B: Sorry, could you say that again?
l-e-m1-b05-32.s.s1.prompt: Kedu okwu ka mma maka onye na-ege ntị?
l-e-m1-b05-32.s.s1.o.a: B. Ọ na-arịọ ọzọ n’ụzọ nkwanye ùgwù.
l-e-m1-b05-32.s.s1.o.b: A. Ọ ka mma n’ihi na ọ dị mkpirikpi ma dị ngwa.
l-e-m1-b05-32.s.s1.r.b: Ọbụna ma ọ dị mkpirikpi, ọ nwere ike ịda ka okwu ike.
l-e-m1-b05-32.s.s1.o.c: A. Ọ dị mfe n’ihi na ọ bụ otu okwu.
l-e-m1-b05-32.s.s1.r.c: Ịdị mfe na ịdị mma abụghị otu ihe.
l-e-m1-b05-32.s.s1.o.d: Ha abụọ bụ otu; ihe ha pụtara bụ otu.
l-e-m1-b05-32.s.s1.r.d: Ọbụna ma ihe ha pụtara bụ otu, mmetụta onye na-ege ntị na-enweta dị iche.
l-e-m1-b05-32.s.s1.explain: Site na Sorry na could you, ị nwere ike ịrịọ otu ihe n’ụzọ nkwanye ùgwù.

l-e-m1-b05-32.s.s2.model.1: A bụ What? naanị, nke nwere ike ịda ike; ya mere B ka mma.

l-e-m1-b06-32.goal: Tụnyere ederede abụọ na-akọwa usoro ụtụtụ, họrọ nke ka mma, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-m1-b06-32.material: Ederede A: I woke up and I ate breakfast and I went to school. Ederede B: First, I woke up. Then I ate breakfast. After that, I went to school.
l-e-m1-b06-32.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ederede na-egosi usoro ihe omume nke ka mma?
l-e-m1-b06-32.s.s1.o.b: A. Ọ bụ otu ahịrịokwu, ya mere ọ dị mkpụmkpụ karịa
l-e-m1-b06-32.s.s1.r.b: Ọbụlagodi na ọ dị mkpụmkpụ, ọ nweghị okwu na-agwa nsonye.
l-e-m1-b06-32.s.s1.o.c: A. and na-ejikọ ihe omume, ya mere ọ bụ nke okike karịa
l-e-m1-b06-32.s.s1.r.c: A na-ekwughachi And, ya mere usoro adịghị doro anya.
l-e-m1-b06-32.s.s1.o.d: Ha bụ otu. Ihe e mere bụ otu
l-e-m1-b06-32.s.s1.r.d: Ọbụna ma ihe e mere bụ otu, otú usoro si doo anya dị iche.
l-e-m1-b06-32.s.s1.explain: Okwu dịka First, Then, After that na-egosi usoro ihe mere ozugbo.
l-e-m1-b06-32.s.s2.model.0: B gosiri usoro na First, Then na After that; ya mere usoro ahụ doo anya karịa.

l-e-m1-b06-33.goal: Tụlee ụzọ abụọ e si edozi ahịrịokwu na-ezighị ezi, họrọ nke ka mma ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-m1-b06-33.material: Sam don’t like tea. Ụmụ akwụkwọ abụọ doziri ya. 1: Sam doesn’t like tea. 2: Sam not like tea.
l-e-m1-b06-33.s.s1.o.a: Nwa akwụkwọ 2. Ịgbakwunye not zuru ezu.
l-e-m1-b06-33.s.s1.r.a: Ahịrịokwu nwere ngwaa nkịtị chọrọ do ma ọ bụ does ka ọ bụrụ ọjọọ.
l-e-m1-b06-33.s.s1.o.b: Ha abụọ ziri ezi, ihe ha pụtara bụ otu.
l-e-m1-b06-33.s.s1.r.b: Ahịrịokwu nwa akwụkwọ 2 abụghị ụtọasụsụ ziri ezi.
l-e-m1-b06-33.s.s1.o.c: Ha abụọ ezighị ezi; don’t ziri ezi.
l-e-m1-b06-33.s.s1.r.c: Sam bụ otu onye; ya mere jiri doesn’t, ọ bụghị don’t.
l-e-m1-b06-33.s.s1.o.d: Nwa akwụkwọ 1. Isiokwu bụ otu, jiri doesn’t.
l-e-m1-b06-33.s.s1.explain: Isiokwu Sam bụ otu (onye 3), ya mere iji doesn’t, ụdị dị mkpirikpi nke does not, mee ka ọ bụrụ ọjọọ.
l-e-m1-b06-33.s.s2.model.0: Sam bụ otu; ya mere doesn’t nke jiri does, ọ bụghị do, ziri ezi.

l-e-m1-b06-34.title: Iji Tụnyere Ụzọ Ịchọta Ihe Okwu Amaghị Pụtara
l-e-m1-b06-34.goal: Tụlee ụzọ abụọ e si achọpụta unhelpful, họrọ nke ka mma ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-m1-b06-34.material: Anyị chọrọ ịmata okwu ọhụrụ unhelpful. A: Kewaa un + help + ful ma jikọta ihe ha pụtara. B: Lee naanị mkpụrụedemede mbụ, chepụta ihe ọ pụtara.
l-e-m1-b06-34.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ụzọ ka mma iji chọta ihe ọ pụtara?
l-e-m1-b06-34.s.s1.o.a: B. Ọ na-echepụta ngwa ngwa, na-echekwa oge.
l-e-m1-b06-34.s.s1.r.a: Mkpụrụedemede mbụ naanị anaghị enye ihe ngosi bara uru.
l-e-m1-b06-34.s.s1.o.b: B. Mkpụrụedemede mbụ na-ekpebi ihe ọ pụtara.
l-e-m1-b06-34.s.s1.r.b: Mkpụrụedemede mbụ anaghị ekpebi ihe ọ pụtara.
l-e-m1-b06-34.s.s1.o.c: A. Enwere ike iwulite ihe ọ pụtara site na prefix na mgbọrọgwụ.
l-e-m1-b06-34.s.s1.o.d: Ha abụọ bụ otu n’ihi na ọ bụ naanị ịkọ nkọ.
l-e-m1-b06-34.s.s1.r.d: A ka a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi n’ihi na o ji iberibe okwu wuo ihe ọ pụtara.
l-e-m1-b06-34.s.s1.explain: Enwere ike iwulite “ọ bụghị enyemaka” site na un (“ọ bụghị”) + help (“inye aka”) + ful (“jupụtara na”).
l-e-m1-b06-34.s.s2.model.0: Ebe un pụtara not, help pụtara inye aka, ful pụtara jupụtara na, A nwere ike iwulite ihe ọ pụtara site n’iberibe a maara.
l-e-m1-b06-34.s.s2.model.1: B siri ike ịtụkwasị obi n’ihi na ọ na-echepụta site na mkpụrụedemede mbụ; A jikọtara ihe iberibe pụtara.

l-e-m1-b06-35.title: Iji Tụnyere Ihe Kpatara Ịhọrọ Akwụkwọ
l-e-m1-b06-35.goal: Tụlee ihe kpatara abụọ e ji ahọrọ akwụkwọ Bekee a ga-agụ, họrọ nke dabara adaba ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-m1-b06-35.material: Ị chọrọ akwụkwọ Bekee dị mfe ịgụ. A: Mkpuchi ya mara mma. B: Ị gụrụ peeji mbụ, ihe fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ okwu ị na-amaghị adịghị.
l-e-m1-b06-35.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ihe kpatara ka dabara maka ịhọrọ akwụkwọ dị mfe ịgụ?
l-e-m1-b06-35.s.s1.o.a: A. Mkpuchi mara mma na-eme ka ịgụ ihe bụrụ ihe na-atọ ụtọ.
l-e-m1-b06-35.s.s1.r.a: Mkpuchi anaghị agwa gị otú ederede siri ike.
l-e-m1-b06-35.s.s1.o.b: B. Enyochara m ọnụọgụ okwu amaghị na peeji mbụ.
l-e-m1-b06-35.s.s1.o.c: A. Ọ pụtara ìhè, ya mere ọ dị mfe ịhọrọ.
l-e-m1-b06-35.s.s1.r.c: Ịpụta ìhè na ịdị mfe ịgụ bụ ihe dị iche.
l-e-m1-b06-35.s.s1.o.d: Ha abụọ bụ otu n’ihi na ọ dabere n’ụtọ mmadụ.
l-e-m1-b06-35.s.s1.r.d: A na-eji okwu dị n’akwụkwọ, ọ bụghị ụtọ mmadụ, ekpebi ma ọ dị mfe ịgụ.
l-e-m1-b06-35.s.s1.explain: Ịgụ akwụkwọ n’onwe gị na ịhụ ma okwu amaghị dị ọtụtụ na-egosi ma ọ dị mfe.
l-e-m1-b06-35.s.s2.model.0: B dabara adaba n’ihi na ịgụ peeji mbụ n’onwe gị na-egosi okwu ole ị na-amaghị.
l-e-m1-b06-35.s.s2.model.1: Mkpuchi anaghị egosi isi ike ederede; ya mere B sitere n’ịgụ n’ezie ka mma.

l-e-m1-b07-07.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ abụọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ maka idozi ahịrị okwu abụọ jikọrọ ọnụ n'enweghị comma, họrọ nke kwesịrị ekwesị karị, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara.
l-e-m1-b07-07.material: Ide enyi: 'I was tired I went to bed.' Ahịrị okwu abụọ ahụ jikọrọ ọnụ, ya mere o siri ike ịgụ. Ị chọrọ idozi ya.

l-e-m1-b07-07.s.s1.r.b: Comma naanị enweghị ike ijikọ ahịrị okwu abụọ.
l-e-m1-b07-07.s.s1.r.d: Mgbe ntụpọ, ị ga-amalitere site na mkpụrụedemede ukwu.
